Subject: Staged remit proposal for renewal — ledger mapping & VAT residuals

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the productive renewal discussion this week. To keep the ledger and AP handoff tidy on both sides, we propose a staged remit approach for the renewal true-up: two invoices rather than a single consolidated bill. High level:

- Invoice A (at renewal): committed capacity and any pre-paid credits.
- Invoice B (30 days after term end): usage true-up and any overage line items.

Why this helps Helix: AP can apply the committed invoice to the existing PO/ledger now, while the true-up is a clearly labeled operational charge with its own ledger mapping (attached). This reduces manual reclassing and speeds collection.

Questions for you / asks from AP:
- Can Helix accept two separate invoices for the same contract (yes/no)?
- If yes, who should Invoice A be addressed to and what PO should we reference?
- For Invoice B we may need either a VAT ID (for reverse-charge) or confirmation of local withholding tax treatment. Do you have a VAT registration number we can record?

Attached: ledger_mapping.xlsx (proposed GL codes and descriptions) and a draft Invoice A (invoice_draft_stage1.pdf) for review.

If that format works, I’ll loop in Finance (Irene) to confirm tax presentation and final invoice language. I can also send a brief amendment to the SOW if we need to explicitly call out the two-invoice flow.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context, Soojin. Confirming Finance position and next steps: 

- Legal entity: Issue both invoices from Redwood Inference Ltd (UK entity) to allow reverse-charge treatment for EU customers. Redwood Inference Ltd VAT ID: GB123456789. Provide this on both invoices and on the invoice footnote indicating "reverse charge - VAT to be accounted for by the recipient".
